evidence: Modifies and adds cryptographic primitives under src/crypto/ (chacha20).
rationale: Vectorizes ChaCha20 to address CPU bottlenecks on the network thread during BIP324 transport, targeting a 2-3x speedup across x86-64 and ARM NEON. The description notes that 'chacha20 accounts for a substantial amount of the network thread's time' and provides 'a 2x speedup on x86-64 and 3x for arm+neon', making this an important performance improvement for core cryptographic primitives.
